description: This Java source file defines the @ExpressionDescription annotation used in Spark SQL to document function descriptions, including usage, arguments, examples, notes, grouping, source, version, and deprecation info.

classes.name: ExpressionDescription
classes.description: Annotation interface for describing Spark SQL functions with metadata such as usage, arguments, examples, notes, grouping, source, version, and deprecation information.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Returns the usage string for the function.

methods.name: extended
methods.description: Deprecated field for extended usage; use other fields instead.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Returns the category group of the function.

methods.name: since
methods.description: Returns the version since the function is available.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Returns the source of the function, e.g., built-in, hive, udf.
